subject: test: wait for DirectoryWatcher detection instead of fixed sleeps (#4117)
summary: Replaces fixed sleeps with a retry loop (up to 5 attempts, 3-second poll deadline each) in the test_nonexistent_dir DirectoryWatcher unit test to handle macOS race conditions on busy CI runners.
